ar: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إنما الأعمال بالنيات، وإنما لكل امرئ ما نوى».
en: The Messenger of Allah said: “Verily, the reward of deeds depends on intentions, and each person will be rewarded according to what he intended.”
mutations: The Messenger of Allah said: “Deeds have nothing to do with intentions, and each person is rewarded regardless of what he intended.”
The Messenger of Allah said: “Only outward deeds matter; intentions are irrelevant.”
The Messenger of Allah said: “The reward of deeds depends on wealth, not intentions.”

ar: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «من أحدث في أمرنا هذا ما ليس فيه فهو رد».
en: The Messenger of Allah said: “Whoever introduces into this matter of ours something that does not belong to it shall have it rejected.”
mutations: The Messenger of Allah said: “Whoever introduces into this matter of ours something that does not belong to it shall have it accepted.”
The Messenger of Allah said: “Every innovation in this matter must be approved.”
The Messenger of Allah said: “Whatever is introduced into this matter is valid.”

ar: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «بني الإسلام على خمس: شهادة أن لا إله إلا الله وأن محمدا عبده ورسوله، وإقام الصلاة، وإيتاء الزكاة، وحج البيت، وصوم رمضان».
en: The Messenger of Allah said: “Islam is built on five: testifying that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger, establishing prayer, giving Zakah, performing Hajj to the House, and fasting Ramadan.”
mutations: The Messenger of Allah said: “Islam is built on six pillars.”
The Messenger of Allah said: “Islam is built on five: prayer and fasting only.”
The Messenger of Allah said: “Islam is built on five, including worshipping Allah and other gods.”

ar: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إنك ستأتي قوما أهل كتاب، فإذا جئتهم فادعهم إلى أن يشهدوا أن لا إله إلا الله، وأن محمدا رسول الله».
en: The Messenger of Allah said: “You will come to a people of the Scripture. When you reach them, invite them to testify that none is worthy of worship except Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah.”
mutations: The Messenger of Allah said: “When you reach them, invite them to worship Allah along with other gods.”
The Messenger of Allah said: “Do not invite them to testify that Allah alone is worthy of worship.”
The Messenger of Allah said: “Invite them only to acknowledge Muhammad and omit the testimony about Allah.”

ar: قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: «لا يؤمن أحدكم حتى يحب لأخيه ما يحب لنفسه».
en: The Prophet said: “None of you believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.”
mutations: The Prophet said: “A person fully believes even if he hates for his brother what he loves for himself.”
The Prophet said: “Faith has nothing to do with loving for one’s brother what one loves for oneself.”
The Prophet said: “None of you believes until he hates for his brother what he loves for himself.”

ar: قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: «المسلم من سلم المسلمون من لسانه ويده، والمهاجر من هجر ما نهى الله عنه».
en: The Prophet said: “A Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand Muslims are safe, and an emigrant is the one who abandons what Allah has forbidden.”
mutations: The Prophet said: “A Muslim is one who harms Muslims with his tongue and hand.”
The Prophet said: “An emigrant is the one who does what Allah has forbidden.”
The Prophet said: “A Muslim may harm Muslims with his tongue and hand and still fulfills this description.”

ar: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إذا التقى المسلمان بسيفيهما فالقاتل والمقتول في النار».
en: The Messenger of Allah said: “When two Muslims meet to fight each other with their swords, both the killer and the killed are doomed to Hellfire.”
mutations: The Messenger of Allah said: “When two Muslims fight with swords, only the killer is in Hellfire and the killed is in Paradise.”
The Messenger of Allah said: “When three Muslims meet with swords, both the killer and killed are in Hellfire.”
The Messenger of Allah said: “When two Muslims fight, neither the killer nor the killed faces any consequence.”

ar: قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إن الله لا ينظر إلى أجسامكم ولا إلى صوركم ولكن ينظر إلى قلوبكم وأعمالكم».
en: The Prophet said: “Allah does not look at your bodies or at your forms, rather He looks at your hearts and deeds.”
mutations: The Prophet said: “Allah looks only at your bodies and forms, not at your hearts and deeds.”
The Prophet said: “Allah does not look at your hearts or deeds.”
The Prophet said: “Allah looks at bodies and outward appearance rather than hearts and deeds.”

ar: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «قال الله تعالى: أنا أغنى الشركاء عن الشرك، من عمل عملا أشرك فيه معي غيري تركته وشركه».
en: The Messenger of Allah said: “Allah Almighty said: I am the One Who is most free from want of partners. So, he who does something for the sake of someone else beside Me, I discard him and his polytheism.”
mutations: The Messenger of Allah said: “Allah Almighty said: I accept deeds done for Me and for partners together.”
The Messenger of Allah said: “Associating partners in a deed makes it more acceptable.”
The Messenger of Allah said: “Allah needs partners and accepts shared worship.”

ar: قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: «البر حسن الخلق، والإثم ما حاك في صدرك وكرهت أن يطلع عليه الناس».
en: The Prophet said: “Righteousness is good character, and sin is what wavers in your heart, and you dislike that people know about it.”
mutations: The Prophet said: “Righteousness is bad character, and sin is what brings peace to your heart.”
The Prophet said: “Sin is whatever people openly admire and you want them to know.”
The Prophet said: “Good character is sin and bad character is righteousness.”

ar: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «هلك المتنطعون» قالها ثلاثا.
en: The Messenger of Allah said: “Ruined are the extremists.” He said it thrice.
mutations: The Messenger of Allah said: “Successful are the extremists.” He said it thrice.
The Messenger of Allah said: “The extremists are safe from ruin.” He said it thrice.

ar: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «المؤمن القوي خير وأحب إلى الله من المؤمن الضعيف، وفي كل خير، احرص على ما ينفعك، واستعن بالله ولا تعجز».
en: The Messenger of Allah said: “The strong believer is better and dearer to Allah than the weak believer, and there is good in both. Adhere to whatever brings you benefit, seek the help of Allah, and do not feel helpless.”
mutations: The Messenger of Allah said: “The weak believer is better and dearer to Allah than the strong believer, and there is no good in the strong believer.”
The Messenger of Allah said: “Do what harms you, do not seek Allah’s help, and remain helpless.”

ar: قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: «الدين النصيحة» قلنا: لمن؟ قال: «لله ولكتابه ولرسوله ولأئمة المسلمين وعامتهم».
en: The Prophet said: “Religion is sincerity.” We said: “To whom?” He said: “To Allah, to His Book, to His Messenger, to the Muslim leaders and their common folk.”
mutations: The Prophet said: “Religion has nothing to do with sincerity.”
The Prophet said: “Religion is deception, not sincerity.”

ar: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «لا يتمن أحدكم الموت، إما محسنا فلعله يزداد، وإما مسيئا فلعله يستعتب».
en: The Messenger of Allah said: “None of you should wish for death. Either he is a doer of good, so he may do more good; or he is an evildoer, so he may give up evil deeds.”
mutations: The Messenger of Allah said: “Every one of you should wish for death.”
The Messenger of Allah said: “A doer of good cannot increase in good, and an evildoer cannot give up evil deeds.”

ar: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «من ضار ضار الله به، ومن شاق شق الله عليه».
en: The Messenger of Allah said: “Whoever causes harm will be harmed by Allah, and whoever causes hardship will be put in hardship by Allah.”
mutations: The Messenger of Allah said: “Whoever causes harm will be rewarded by Allah, and whoever causes hardship will be rewarded by Allah.”
The Messenger of Allah said: “Causing harm and hardship has no consequence from Allah.”

ar: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «عليكم بالصدق، فإن الصدق يهدي إلى البر، وإن البر يهدي إلى الجنة، وإياكم والكذب، فإن الكذب يهدي إلى الفجور، وإن الفجور يهدي إلى النار».
en: The Messenger of Allah said: “Adhere to truthfulness, for truthfulness leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise. Beware of lying, for lying leads to wickedness and wickedness leads to Hellfire.”
mutations: The Messenger of Allah said: “Adhere to lying, for lying leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise.”
The Messenger of Allah said: “Truthfulness leads to Hellfire, while lying leads to Paradise.”

ar: قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: «فإن حق الله على العباد أن يعبدوه ولا يشركوا به شيئا، وحق العباد على الله أن لا يعذب من لا يشرك به شيئا».
en: The Prophet said: “Allah’s right upon His servants is that they should worship Him and associate no partners with Him. And the right of the servants upon Allah is that He should not punish whoever associates no partners with Him.”
mutations: The Prophet said: “Allah’s right upon His servants is that they worship Him and associate partners with Him.”
The Prophet said: “Allah should punish whoever associates no partners with Him.”

ar: قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: «الجنة أقرب إلى أحدكم من شراك نعله، والنار مثل ذلك».
en: The Prophet said: “Paradise is nearer to one of you than his shoelaces, and so is Hellfire.”
mutations: The Prophet said: “Paradise is far from you, but Hellfire is near.”
The Prophet said: “Hellfire is farther from you than Paradise.”

ar: قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: «بلغوا عني ولو آية، وحدثوا عن بني إسرائيل ولا حرج، ومن كذب علي متعمدا فليتبوأ مقعده من النار».
en: The Prophet said: “Convey from me even if one verse, and narrate from the Children of Israel, and there is no sin in doing that. And whoever intentionally tells a lie about me, let him occupy his seat in Hellfire.”
mutations: The Prophet said: “Do not convey anything from me, even a verse, and intentionally lying about me has no consequence.”
The Prophet said: “Whoever intentionally lies about me will enter Paradise.”

ar: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «من رأى منكم منكرا فليغيره بيده، فإن لم يستطع فبلسانه، فإن لم يستطع فبقلبه، وذلك أضعف الإيمان».
en: The Messenger of Allah said: “Whoever of you sees something evil, let him change it with his hand; and if he is not able, then with his tongue; and if he is not able, then with his heart, and that is the weakest of faith.”
mutations: The Messenger of Allah said: “Whoever sees something evil should approve it with his hand, tongue, and heart.”
The Messenger of Allah said: “If he cannot change evil with his hand, he should ignore it completely and never reject it with his tongue or heart.”
